author.name: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
author.heading: About Nassim Nicholas Taleb
author.bio: Nassim Nicholas Taleb (born 1960) is a Lebanese-American essayist, researcher and former financial trader. His Incerto books examine uncertainty, risk and the gap between formal models and lived experience; The Bed of Procrustes presents related ideas in short aphorisms rather than extended proofs.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The Bed of Procrustes collects brief observations about human freedom, imposed systems and self-deception. Its title invokes the myth of making people fit an inflexible bed. The procrastination line reads resistance through that metaphor; it is an aphorism about constraint, not a comprehensive psychological account of delaying tasks.
